prompt:
A sprite sheet of 4 separate objects for a top-down JRPG map, to be placed on top of the painted map shown in the reference image. Match the reference exactly: the same hi-bit pixel-painting style and brushwork, the same palette and material textures, the same soft light from the upper left (lit tops and left sides, shaded right sides), the same classic steep 3/4 top-down view (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 2 x 2 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom) with wide empty space between them; every object fully separate, nothing touching, nothing cut off. Draw each object large, filling most of its grid cell. The objects, in order: 1) village street lamp: dark wooden post with a small iron lantern hanging from an arm (unlit); 2) small iron lantern standing on the ground (unlit); 3) small wooden signpost with a blank plank sign; 4) small cluster of pale teal glowing mushrooms.
Background: fully transparent. No ground, no floor, no shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers. Even albedo lighting: no night, no glow halos and no light spilling around the objects (lamps unlit).
revised_prompt: Create a transparent-background sprite sheet containing exactly FOUR separate, large top-down JRPG map object sprites in a 2×2 grid, reading order. Use the user-provided village map image as the visual style reference: closely match its detailed hi-bit pixel-painting brushwork, slightly dithered hand-painted pixel textures, earthy dark wood and iron palette, and classic steep three-quarter top-down orthographic view with visible top surfaces and front faces. Gentle even daylight from upper left, highlighted upper and left edges and shaded right edges. Top-left: upright village street lamp consisting of a tall dark brown wooden post with a small dark iron lantern hanging from a short projecting arm, lantern UNLIT, glass dark. Top-right: a standalone small black iron lantern standing upright on its own base, UNLIT, no flame or light. Bottom-left: short wooden signpost with one broad BLANK weathered wooden plank sign, no markings. Bottom-right: a compact cluster of several pale teal subtly luminous mushrooms with short stems and visible cap tops; softly bright mushroom bodies only, no halos or spill light. Each object large and centered within its cell, all four wholly separated by generous clear empty space, no overlapping or cropping. ABSOLUTELY transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no ground, no floor, no cast shadows, no captions, no labels, no numbers, no extra objects. Preserve clean hard sprite silhouettes and surface detail.
